hero.body_1: Performance is not a personal trait. It's a pattern that emerges from how your habits, mindset, and environment operate under pressure.
hero.body_2: High performance isn't about effort alone. It's about how well your personal system holds together when it matters most.
hero.body_3: Using the Readyneering framework, you'll gain practical tools to:
hero.list_2: Maintain confidence and composure when conditions are unstable
hero.list_3: Act with credibility when it matters most

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.body: Readiness is the system that builds mental robustness through preparation and resilience, supported by a mindset of humility that sustains trust, morale, and focus.

resilience.title: Resilience
resilience.body: Seven pillars to remain calm amid the storm and enable swift, decisive decision-making.

preparedness.title: Preparedness
preparedness.body: Following a pilot's approach of "expect the unexpected": facts, emotions, solutions.

info.title: Five quotients of readiness
info.desc: Hover a quotient node to explore. Each is assessed under pressure and by structural design.

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality.dr: How well you sustain energy, focus and pace under prolonged pressure without burning out.
vitality.dp: Whether capacity, recovery cycles and wellbeing practices are deliberately built into your personal system.

emotion.name: Emotion
emotion.dr: How well you regulate emotional responses during conflict, failure and uncertainty.
emotion.dp: Whether you prepare in advance for predictable emotional patterns in high-pressure situations.

mind.name: Mind
mind.dr: The quality of your thinking and decision-making when data is incomplete and time is short.
mind.dp: Whether scenario thinking, pre-mortems and assumption-testing are built into how you prepare.

execution.name: Execution
execution.dr: How decisively and consistently you act under constraint and real-time pressure.
execution.dp: Whether priorities, decision rules and action plans are defined before pressure peaks.

alignment.name: Alignment
alignment.dr: Whether you stay coherent - values, priorities, roles and commitments - when under stress.
alignment.dp: Whether your goals, commitments and boundaries are clarified before competing demands intensify.

questionnaire.body: You will encounter 20 real organizational situations. For each one, place your dot inside the triangle - closer to whichever corner rings most true. No right answers. The geometry reveals your readiness profile.
questionnaire.body_2: You’ll choose between competing realities-not ideal answers.
questionnaire.body_meta: Responses combine into a system-level profile—not independent scores.
questionnaire.warn: Please place your dot in the triangle before continuing.

results.main-sub-title-2: Where you are strongest - and where you have room to grow
results.main-sub-description-2: These scores reflect your patterns across all 20 scenarios - four for each of the andQfive Quotients. They are not a judgement of you as a person - they show how the environment you operate in tends to behave under pressure. This report is relevant whether you lead a team, work as part of one, or both.
results.loader-body: Analyzing system patterns across resilience, preparedness, and the five quotients.
results.loader-body-pre: Your answers are being securely saved before we build your profile.
results.score-description: Readiness = Preparedness × Resilience. The multiplication is deliberate - someone who collapses on one dimension is not ready, regardless of how strong the other is.
results.turnstile-copy: We’re checking this is a genuine assessment before saving your results.
results.turnstile-copy-2: One moment while we set up verification…
results.turnstile-loading-failed: Still setting up… check your connection and try again.
results.mode-tag-both-strong: Genuinely ready — protect this and help others build it
results.mode-tag-both-low: The foundation needs work across both dimensions
results.mode-tag-preparedness-high-resilience-lo: Strong direction and execution, but the personal resilience foundation is fragile
results.mode-tag-resilience-high-preparedness-lo: Relying on individual effort where shared habits and clearer thinking could do the work
results.mode-tag-both-building-or-higher: Solid across both dimensions — the priority now is consistency under sustained pressure
results.focus-subtitle-single: This comes directly from your lowest-scoring quotient —
results.focus-subtitle-multiple: These come directly from your two lowest-scoring quotients —

callout.intro: These three priorities come from where your scores are lowest across the Five Quotients.
callout.reminder: Remember: Readiness = Preparedness × Resilience. A gap in either dimension cannot be covered by strength in the other.
callout.final_with_chips: Small, consistent shifts in {chips} will do more than a significant effort in an area where you are already strong.
callout.final_fallback: Small, consistent shifts where your scores are lowest will do more than a significant effort in an area where you are already strong.
